_comment: Example: TRX transfer using TransferContract. Amount is in SUN (1 TRX = 1,000,000 SUN). The 'from' and 'owner_address' fields will be automatically updated by the test task to match the derived Tron address. The 'to_address' is the recipient. You can use either base58 (T...) or hex (41...) address formats - they will be automatically converted.
